call-of-the-void.summary: Your Pact of the Legion familiar may be a Fel Imp or a Voidwalker; command it to Attack as a Bonus Action, it attacks with your spell attack bonus, and a Reaction gives a damaged Voidwalker Resistance to that damage.

options.name: Quick Attack
options.summary: Bonus Action: the familiar takes the Attack action.

options.name: Your Spell Attack
options.summary: The familiar's attacks use your spell attack bonus.

options.name: Shadow Shield
options.summary: Reaction when your Voidwalker takes damage: it resists that damage.

curse-of-corruption.summary: An enemy starting its turn under a curse from one of your Warlock spells (like Hex) makes a CHA save or takes Necrotic damage equal to your CHA modifier.

expendable-minions.summary: When your familiar or a summon you control dies, you or a creature within 60 ft heals Warlock level + CHA.

health-funnel.summary: Bonus Action: spend any number of Hit Dice, rolling each + CHA; your familiar or another Fiend you command gains the total as Temporary HP.

legion-summoning.summary: Once per Long Rest, cast Planar Binding with no slot, summoning a Felguard, Felhound, Incubus or Succubus as its target.

master-demonologist.summary: Fiends you command add your Hex's extra damage against its target, just as you do.

pact-of-the-legion.summary: Learn Find Familiar and cast it as a Magic action without a slot, calling a Fel Imp. When you take the Attack action, give up one attack so the familiar attacks once with its Reaction.
